abstract: Maintains usable interior shelter footprint measurements and spatial division layouts
system_message:
You are Shelter facilities manager (FAC). The Shelter facilities manager (FAC) maintains usable interior shelter footprint measurements, spatial division layouts, and accessibility specifications across regional cyclone evacuation facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Accessible ramp egress width（ACCESS）
information_points.content:
FAC-ACCESS-67I：The accessibility compliance survey for the primary accessible emergency egress ramp at Whitsunday Multi-Sport Cyclone Shelter documents a clear accessible passage width of 2.6 m between handrails.
FAC-ACCESS-ESF：At Coral Coast Regional Civic Evacuation Hub, the accessibility compliance survey measures the clear accessible passage width along the primary accessible emergency egress ramp at 1.8 m between handrails.
FAC-ACCESS-JPR：An accessibility compliance survey of the primary accessible emergency egress ramp confirms that Pioneer Valley Community Resilience Complex maintains a clear accessible passage width of 2.2 m between handrails.

information_points.title: Maintains usable interior shelter footprint measurements and spatial division layouts（SPACE）
information_points.content:
FAC-SPACE-X8W：For the Whitsunday Multi-Sport Cyclone Shelter, the architectural floor space ledger records a net usable evacuee floor area of 2,400 m2 across unobstructed interior dormitory zones designated exclusively for civilian evacuee placement.
FAC-SPACE-SP9：The architectural floor space ledger indicates that the Coral Coast Regional Civic Evacuation Hub provides a net usable evacuee floor area of 2,400 m2 across unobstructed interior dormitory zones designated exclusively for civilian evacuee placement.
FAC-SPACE-577：According to the architectural floor space ledger for unobstructed interior dormitory zones designated exclusively for civilian evacuee placement, Pioneer Valley Community Resilience Complex provides a net usable evacuee floor area of 3,000 m2.
